recipe.visualDefinition: A four-person group portrait in Victorian-era attire, framed within a large gray border featuring bold, yellow sans-serif typography and small red triangular accents.
coreVisualRelationships: Central rectangular image inset within a thick neutral gray frame
High-contrast yellow typography against a muted gray background
Repetitive red triangular motifs acting as bullet points or directional markers
Dark, moody lighting on the subjects contrasting with the flat, graphic border
coreInvariants: Subjects in dark formal wear with hats

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four men seated in a row, occupying the central 60% of the vertical space within a defined rectangle.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, oversized initial letter in the top left corner of the layout.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large top-left character, moves across the top text, drops to the central portrait, and follows the vertical line of triangles to the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial gray margins on all four sides, creating a 'window' effect for the photography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Medium neutral gray background providing a flat, industrial canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright lemon yellow for primary and secondary text elements.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Small red triangles providing rhythmic punctuation.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the graphic elements (yellow/red) against low saturation in the background and photographic subject matter.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavyweight geometric sans-serif with rounded terminals.
letterConstructionRules: Oversized initial character for the main title
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial letter scaled to approximately 300% of the following characters
Hyphens replaced by red triangular glyphs
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family variation using scale and tracking to differentiate hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Vertical column of triangles as a divider

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric weight and circular counters.
Captures the soft terminals and heavy presence.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a group portrait of four men in 19th-century English attire (bowler hats, top hats, waistcoats) sitting in a row against a dark, slightly textured background. Place this image inside a central rectangular frame on a solid, matte medium-gray canvas.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase yellow text in a heavy geometric sans-serif. Place the main title at the top with a massive first letter. Place the subtitle at the bottom. Insert small red downward-pointing triangles between top letters and in a vertical line leading to the bottom text.

verificationChecks: Is the first letter significantly larger than the rest?
Are there red triangles used as spacers?
Is the background a flat, neutral gray?
Is the central image a distinct rectangle?

adjustableVariables: Number of men in the portrait
Specific shade of gray for the border
Tracking width of the bottom text
Number of red triangles in the vertical stack
mustRedesign: Corporate logos in the bottom corners

mustAchieve: Balanced negative space in the margins

postGenerationChecks: Check that the red triangles are uniform in size.
Ensure the yellow text is legible against the gray.
Verify the Victorian costumes are consistent across all four subjects.
Confirm the large initial letter does not overlap the central image.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central portrait + Thick gray border + Oversized yellow initial + Red triangle punctuation = 80s Graphic Rock Aesthetic.
